en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3854 - Al-Hasan bin Mahbub narrated from Zayd Al-Shahham who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (as) about a man who purchases shares from butchers before the shares are distributed.
Imam (as) said: "If he purchases a share, then he has the option to accept or reject it when it is distributed."
